trial_definition: Separate UTC days; fresh engine and zero inventory each midnight; both legs liquidated at final executable prices with taker fees
hypothesis: H0: mean daily realized PnL <= 0; H1: mean > 0
interpretation: Threshold selected after inspecting historical sensitivity plots; ordinary t-test is an in-sample diagnostic, conditional on independence assumptions.
independence_note: Resetting positions removes inventory carryover but does not guarantee statistically independent or stationary market days.

methods.primary: One-sided one-sample t-test across daily trial endpoints, df=n-1; 95% two-sided t interval
methods.robustness: Daily autocorrelation and Ljung-Box diagnostics; Newey-West HAC at 3/7 lags and centered circular block bootstrap at 3/7-day block lengths

limitations: Strategy and threshold selected using previously inspected history.
Daily resets do not remove common market regimes or serial dependence.
Spot last-trade proxy, assumed spread, zero latency and simplified maker fills; borrowing, impact, depth, margin and liquidation omitted.

dependence_diagnostics.acf_definition: Demeaned autocovariance divided by full-sample sum of squared residuals
dependence_diagnostics.interpretation: Ljung-Box tests zero autocorrelation through each lag; failure to reject does not establish independence or stationarity.

summary.strategy: passive perp basis entry, immediate equal-BTC spot hedge
summary.exit_execution: Opposite entry threshold closes both legs to flat at taker prices; that signal episode cannot reopen; any enabled funding exits remain active
summary.capacity_rule: One signed order-sized basis position; no opposite entries until flat
summary.funding_assumption: Recorded settlement cash flows on held positions
summary.funding_signal: Causal weighted average of completed 1m premium-index CLOSE proxies; not exact exchange forecast
summary.limitations: Open positions marked at mids; closed pairs use both executable exit sides and all four leg fees. Spot price-only input uses last-trade proxy with assumed spread. Borrow availability, interest, impact, depth, margin and liquidation are not modeled. No queue reconstruction. Midpoint convergence does not guarantee a positive executable round trip.
